services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: The boat is in the water and ready to take you out! Our season runs until October We are Rochesters only BYOB party boat which means you can bring your own alcohol. You are welcome to bring cans of beer, seltzer, hard lemonade and iced teas and canned cocktails like high noons. For the wine drinkers you can bring the juice boxes and small plastic bottles it comes in. You sit around a countertop which makes it easy to bring food, eat the food and store the food when you aren’t eating. Groups bring things like charcuterie boards, sub trays, pizzas and lots of homemade food. The tour is 100 minutes and you party on the boat. Tours start at $350 weekdays (monday-thursday) and $400 for weekends

services.name: multi bike tours
services.desc: We have 4 bikes operating that can be rented at the same time for groups of up to 56 people out. Featuring two 15 and two 13 seat bikes. While you can rent two bikes with as little as 16 people when you book the second bike you are locked into renting two bikes so you want to make sure you will need them. You tell the driver how many guests will be coming when they call you a few days before your tour. For multi bike tours we encourage groups to go from Beer Park to Playhouse or Lux. You do not have to pick this route but depending on the number of guests not every bar is doable. Everything takes longer with 2 bikes from taking photos to groups getting drinks at the bar.
